## 🖼️ Edge to edge

**Edge to edge** is one switch in ⚙: it takes the card's own chrome away — the title bar fades in over the content when you hover, the padding goes, and the card's own title goes with it — so the thing *is* the card.

It is offered where the content is something you look at, not text or a table: the **Gallery** (including its Single image and Story modes), the **Video / Media Player**, the **360° Panorama**, and now the **QR Code**, the **Document Reader**, the **IA Book** and the **Wiki Page**.

Two rules hold, because chrome must never take information with it: a **warning** stays (the video player's *"N not found"* line), and a **control the content needs** stays (a playlist's transport; the page-turn toolbar and the source link on the readers below).

Hover any card here to bring its title bar back — and **⛶** on that bar puts the card, not the board, full screen (Escape leaves). The embedded page above has the wiki page widget’s **Crop the page’s own header** on, because Objectium draws its own header and sidebar; it is a crop of that page, not a setting Objectium knows about.
